tools.name: list_dossiers
tools.description: List every published AB[500] artist dossier (name, slug, subtitle, editions, tier, updated date). Start here to discover which artists have a biography available.

tools.name: search_artists
tools.description: Search AB[500] artist dossiers by name or keyword; returns matching artists with their slugs. Use before get_dossier when you don't know the exact slug.

tools.name: get_dossier
tools.description: Get one artist's full structured biography by slug: subtitle, essay prose (markdown), identity (born/based/practice), works, images, and the verified bibliography with source URLs. Prose is CC0.

tools.name: get_otdh_methodology
tools.description: Get the definition, formulas, full-universe coverage, limitations, discussion URL, and snapshot metadata for AB5D's artist-level Oeuvre Total Days Held metric.

tools.name: list_artist_otdh
tools.description: List the ranked oTDH records for all 308 AB[500] artists, or a limited leading subset. oTDH is a price-independent signal of current uninterrupted collector holding duration.

tools.name: get_artist_otdh
tools.description: Get one artist's oTDH rank, score, collector breadth, raw collector-days, project count, and snapshot metadata by AB5D artist slug.

tools.name: list_artist_collector_tdh
tools.description: List all 308 artist-specific collector TDH dashboard records, including each metric label, route, data URL and verified or pending source status.

tools.name: get_artist_collector_tdh
tools.description: Get one artist-specific collector TDH register by AB5D artist slug. Collector rows are paginated because large Raster-indexed oeuvres can contain thousands of current addresses.

tools.name: list_open_bounties
tools.description: List every AB5D bounty that is currently open for claim, including reward, eligibility, claim route, submission route, protocol, and acceptance command. Only returned tasks are current offers.

tools.name: get_bounty
tools.description: Get one AB5D bounty task by identifier, including its current status and operational routes. Do not begin work unless the returned status is open.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Find AB[500] artworks and series by title or artist. Returns canonical links and native app handoffs.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Read one canonical project with links to its published essay, artist dossiers and artwork license.

tools.name: get_artwork
tools.description: Look up a minted edition through the existing artwork API. Returns render and indexed public owner with timestamp, not full transfer history.

tools.name: find_acquisition_opportunities
tools.description: Rank indexed AB[500] asks by ETH per added percentage point of edition ownership. Excludes linked owner wallets and stops before a 50% asking-price jump. Prices are unverified, gas excluded; each row is a budget alternative, not a basket.

tools.name: get_collection_holdings
tools.description: Read AB5D institutional holdings and public credit lines from the existing cache. Reports pending data honestly.

tools.name: search_public_collectors
tools.description: Search the already-published collector register. No private account access or inferred identity; wallet arrays are omitted.

tools.name: get_donor_credits
tools.description: Find published accession and donor credit records. Absence is unknown, never an inferred donor.

tools.name: compare_project_prices
tools.description: Compare current indexed ETH/WETH lowest asking prices for up to ten chosen projects. Lowest ask is an affordability comparison, not intrinsic value or a return forecast. No trading.

tools.name: prepare_artwork_display
tools.description: Prepare a verified artwork or series display URL and existing mobile Cast workflow. Does not connect to a TV or start playback.

tools.name: discover_apps
tools.description: Find curated AB5D capabilities and apps listed on abx.io. Returns browser/app handoffs, not installation or execution.

tools.name: get_abx_service_info
tools.description: Read the documented ABX public service descriptor. Does not log in, register projects, sign, deploy or create credentials.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_abx_service_info" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Read the documented ABX public service descriptor. Does not log in, register projects, sign, deploy or create credentials.
